actionable_steps.citation: Do Not Burden Yourself With Limitless Desires — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-05-02
actionable_steps.step: When anger overtakes you, put it down immediately as your enemy — and raise patience as your shield of protection.

actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate forgiveness and love — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-01
actionable_steps.step: In times of difficulty, bring tolerance and an attitude of forgiveness into play instead of getting upset or sinking into depression.

actionable_steps.citation: Three types of road — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 6 (1966), 1966-05-23
actionable_steps.step: Bear with others with patience and understanding — discover points of contact, not of conflict.
Don't wait for the waves to stop before you bathe — learn the art of bearing joy and grief with equanimity.
When you are invaded by anger, practise silence or remember the Name of the Lord — do not remind yourself of things that will inflame the anger more.

definition.citation: The Form of God is Love — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-07-02
definition.quote: Forbearance is the real beauty in this sacred land of Bharat. … In fact, sahana (tolerance) is the most valuable and sacred mantra of the Bharatiyas (Indians). … The foremost quality expected of a devotee is forbearance.

discourses.citation: Do Not Burden Yourself With Limitless Desires — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-05-02
discourses.quote: It is said that anger is your enemy, patience is your shield of protection, happiness is your heaven.

discourses.citation: Cultivate forgiveness and love — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-01
discourses.quote: Only when we face problems and difficulties that cause grief and misery this quality of forbearance and forgiveness has the scope for taking root. When you are confronted with problems and difficulties you should not get upset, and become victims of depression which is a sign of weakness.

discourses.citation: Love Is The Greatest Binding Force — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-05
discourses.quote: Forbearance is like the very eye of man. Forbearance is truth, Forbearance is righteousness, Forbearance is the teaching of the Vedas, Forbearance is nonviolence, Forbearance is sacrifice.

discourses.citation: Three types of road — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 6 (1966), 1966-05-23
discourses.quote: Bear with others, with patience and understanding; practise Sahana and Sympathy. Try to discover points of contacts, not of conflicts.

make_it_real: Patience isn't waiting for the storm to pass — it's learning to stand steady in the rain.
title: Patience & Forbearance

vahinis.quote: Patience is all the strength one needs.

Wear the armour of fortitude, and the blows of good and bad fortune can never harm you. … Patiently putting up with the external world of duality combined with inner equanimity and peace — that is the path to liberation.
